description: Functions and classes for working with Itasca cfd elements.

functions.name: count
functions.description: Get the number of CFD elements.

functions.name: face_count
functions.description: Get the number of faces per CFD element.

functions.name: find
functions.description: Get the CFD element object with the given ID number.

functions.name: inbox
functions.signature: itasca.element.cfd.inbox(lower_bound: vec, upper_bound: vec, intersect=True) -> Tuple of CFD element objects
functions.description: Get a tuple of CFD elements with extents intersecting a box. The extent is the axis-aligned bounding box of the CFD element. The if the optional keyword argument intersect is False then only CFD elements with positions falling in the box are returned.

functions.name: list
functions.description: Get a CFD element iterator object.

functions.name: maxid
functions.description: Get the maximum CFD element ID.

functions.name: near
functions.signature: itasca.element.cfd.near(point: vec, radius=0.0) -> CFD element object
functions.description: Find the closest CFD element to a point. If the optional keyword argument radius is non-zero, only search within this radius.

functions.name: node_count
functions.description: Get the number of nodes per CFD element.
